title: How to advertise from ChatGPT with no ad accounts (2026)

facts.fact: Adwave ad campaigns are bought from a prepaid wallet, with campaigns starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: buys media on streaming TV, Meta, Google Search, YouTube, Reddit and the web from a prepaid wallet, starting at $30 a day

facts.fact: Adwave's ads start at $30 a day from a prepaid wallet, with no contract.
facts.quote: Ads start at $30 a day from a prepaid wallet, with no contract.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, connecting ChatGPT to Adwave is free.
facts.quote: Connecting ChatGPT to Adwave is free.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, launching or resuming a campaign sets the day's budget aside from the wallet, and the next morning the user is charged for what ran, never more than the amount set aside.
facts.quote: The next morning you’re charged for what ran, never more than the amount set aside.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, a daily campaign budget repeats until the campaign is paused or ended.
facts.quote: A daily budget repeats until you pause or end the campaign.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, extra ads made through an assistant are billed from the wallet at published prices.
facts.quote: Extra ads made through an assistant can be billed from the wallet at published prices.

facts.fact: According to OpenAI's documentation as checked on Adwave's page, ChatGPT gives custom MCP servers full write access only on Business and Enterprise workspaces.
facts.quote: ChatGPT gives custom servers full write access only on Business and Enterprise workspaces

facts.fact: On ChatGPT's Pro plan, custom MCP servers have read and fetch permissions only, according to OpenAI's documentation as summarized on Adwave's page.
facts.quote: Custom MCP servers with read and fetch permissions only

facts.fact: On ChatGPT Business, only admins and owners can create and publish custom servers, according to OpenAI's documentation as summarized on Adwave's page.
facts.quote: Only admins and owners can create and publish custom servers

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, campaigns run in the US and Canada only.
facts.quote: campaigns run in the US and Canada only.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, the channels are streaming TV, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Search, YouTube, Reddit and the web, with TikTok as opt-in early access and Pinterest coming soon.
facts.quote: TikTok is opt-in early access. Pinterest is coming soon.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, Adwave does not do organic social posting, email newsletters or SEO.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn’t do organic social posting, email newsletters or SEO.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, after a campaign is reviewed by each channel, ads usually start within a few hours.
facts.quote: They usually start within a few hours.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, the Adwave server URL for ChatGPT is https://waverunner.adwave.com/api/mcp.
As of the page date, Adwave is not listed in ChatGPT's plugin directory, so users must add it manually with the server URL.
facts.quote: As of the date above, Adwave isn’t listed in ChatGPT’s plugin directory

facts.fact: Per Adwave's page, card top-ups add a processing fee that is shown at checkout.
facts.quote: Card top-ups add the processing fee shown at checkout.
